{{Top|leg}}
The '''Blackshackle''' [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was a fleet in the [[Blazing Chain]], led by [[Adacap]] [[Zonsoe]]. When Zonsoe fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], the Blackshackle fleet was led on a campaign against the rest of the Blazing Chain. The Blackshackle fleet defeated the [[Arcblade]] fleet, but was eventually destroyed.<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
